title: TensorPyPy: Tensor-Aware Meta-Tracing JIT Compiler
description:
TensorPyPy is a fork of PyPy whose RPython meta-tracing JIT compiler provides a tensor runtime, MetaTensor. Traced chains of tensor operations in the Python program become fused GPU kernels. The code is in rpython/metatensor/, pypy/module/_metatensor/ and lib_pypy/tensorpypy/, and benchmark/ holds the MetaTensor benchmarks.

benchmark/motion/ contains a prototype of MOTION, a method that derives the program transition for a change in the execution environment from interpreter code instead of writing it by hand. The example change is leave: a worker leaves a group computation before its contribution is committed, and a declared reason decides whether that contribution is kept or removed.

The prototype consists of:

  • a 7-line change rule (pypy/module/_metatensor/rule_leave.py), compiled by the meta-tracer like other interpreter code;
  • a static check (benchmark/eval/audit_rules.py) that the rule uses only the abstract interface in motion_iface.py, and a non-conforming rule (benchmark/motion/rule_leave_leaky.py) that the check rejects;
  • an independent checker (benchmark/motion/check_leave.py) that compares the generated transition with an interpreter-only run;
  • a hand-written adapter for comparison (benchmark/motion/adapter_leave.py), and a script (benchmark/motion/count_lines.py) that counts the hand-written lines of each.

This repository is a snapshot of the development repository without history, benchmark results, raw data or internal notes. Upstream PyPy files are under LICENSE, and the TensorPyPy and MetaTensor additions are under the MIT license in LICENSE-tensorpypy.
